correctness.rationale: For every prime exponent, rho_p(1)>1 and rho_p(a)<1 at a>=2; replacing high head exponents and all tail higher exponents by 1 provides a pointwise product majorant. Chinese remainder conditional prime divisibility and absolutely convergent divisor-series moments give EZ and EZ^2. A variance identity and rational prime-sum bounds give B1=71/5000 and B2=31/50000. One- and two-moment Markov bounds applied statewise give the finite rational sum. Standalone integer/rational checker recomputes the 2,097,152 cases and establishes strict <4/5; the universal step is separately proved.
